data.notes: May 2026 in São Paulo mixes stadium-scale pop and rock, Brazilian legacy concerts, C6 Fest, and select electronic club programming.

events.title: The Weeknd: After Hours Til Dawn
events.summary: The Weeknd plays the São Paulo May 1 date of the After Hours Til Dawn stadium tour at MorumBIS. Ticketmaster lists Anitta joining the Brazil dates.

events.title: Portal do Amanhã by Bybit
events.summary: Tomorrowland Brasil’s official one-year countdown event for 2027 takes place at Parque Villa-Lobos with music, energy, and an audiovisual experience. The official site confirms May 1 in São Paulo.

events.title: Djavan: Djavanear 50 anos — Só Sucessos
events.summary: Djavan opens the national 'Djavanear 50 anos. Só Sucessos' stadium tour with two São Paulo dates at Allianz Parque. The show celebrates five decades of the Alagoas-born singer-songwriter’s career.

events.title: Dream Theater: 40th Anniversary Tour Parasomnia 2026
events.summary: Dream Theater brings its Parasomnia 2026 Brazil run to Vibra São Paulo. Clube do Ingresso lists the São Paulo show for May 9 with doors at 18:30 and showtime at 20:30.

events.title: GOMELYXORDIA presents Legowelt (live) & Gabbs
events.summary: GOMELYXORDIA hosts Dutch electro/techno figure Legowelt for a live set alongside Gabbs. Resident Advisor confirms the May 8 date at Palacete in central São Paulo.

events.title: Jonas Brothers: Greetings From Your Hometown
events.summary: Jonas Brothers bring the Greetings From Your Hometown tour to Allianz Parque for a São Paulo stadium date. Ticketmaster lists the performance for May 13, 2026.

events.title: Korn
events.summary: Korn plays its only Brazil show of this South American run at Allianz Parque. Eventim confirms the São Paulo date for May 16, 2026.

events.title: Mon Laferte: Femme Fatale Tour
events.summary: Mon Laferte returns to Brazil with the Femme Fatale Tour for a single São Paulo performance. Ticketmaster confirms the May 16 show at Espaço Unimed.

events.title: t.A.T.u. in São Paulo
events.summary: Bandsintown lists t.A.T.u.’s São Paulo show for May 16, 2026 at Komplexo Tempo. The listing describes it as the group’s first Brazil performance.

events.title: C6 Fest São Paulo 2026
events.summary: C6 Fest occupies Parque Ibirapuera from May 21 to 24 with a global program spanning jazz, electronic, experimental rock, pop, and MPB. The official site confirms the 2026 São Paulo dates and venue.

events.title: Barão Vermelho — Encontro SP
events.summary: Barão Vermelho’s Encontro project plays Allianz Parque in São Paulo. Eventim confirms the May 23 date and 19:00 event time.

events.title: Lenine: EITA
events.summary: Lenine brings the live show for 'EITA' to Tokio Marine Hall in São Paulo. Ticketmaster confirms the May 30 date and lists the touring band lineup.
